15.text:
<C:0007,0000,><C:0001,0001,><C:0001,0004,>- Here Lies a Hero of Buffness -
Muscle Lord Benchor<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>Amid the sweaty furore of the Bodybuilding Siege,
Benchor alone kept both his wits and his reps.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>Prone on the battlefield, he pressed all who tried
to cross the field into the vault of the sky.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>Like an angry gym deity, he kept his core taut
as he lifted foes skyward...earthward...skyward.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>Here he lies for eternity, the earth a damp
bench from which he will never again rise.<C:0003,0001,>
